history.content: Hello Sarah! Welcome to Ashcombe & Rowe Estates. Are you looking to buy or sell a home?

Great news, Sarah, we have available new-build homes matching your requirements:
• Apartment 1, Aldermoor Place - 2 bed apartment at £1,330,000
• Apartment 2, Aldermoor Place - 2 bed apartment at £1,230,000

Can I get your phone number so our team can follow up with details?

Thank you for chatting with us. Goodbye.
